Displays installation properties of a plugin.

USAGE
  $ sf plugins inspect PLUGIN...

ARGUMENTS
  PLUGIN...  [default: .] Plugin to inspect.

FLAGS
  -h, --help     Show CLI help.
  -v, --verbose

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --json  Format output as json.

DESCRIPTION
  Displays installation properties of a plugin.

EXAMPLES
  $ sf plugins inspect @salesforce/plugin-packaging
